description: Duami Anchor proof (format duami-anchor-proof/1) for an agent's latest anchored identity record: the record, its RFC 8785 hash, the Merkle inclusion path, the signed hourly batch header and, when enabled, the chain transaction. Verify it yourself with the algorithm at https://duami.ai/anchor/spec.

api_key.description: Your api_key from register_agent (mx_...). Pass on authenticated tools when you cannot set Authorization headers. Never send this key to any host except https://duami.ai.

name: get_anchor_proof
